decode_video_frames: decode a video file and sample frames using pyav or torchvision backend with temporal sampling
temporal_sampling_frames: sample a fixed number of evenly spaced frames from a video tensor between start and end indices
get_clip_start_end_idx: calculate the start and end frame indices for a video clip using random or uniform sampling strategy
pyav_decode_stream_frames: decode video frames from a PyAV container stream between specific presentation timestamps
torchvision_decode_video: decode video frames from raw bytes using torchvision with selective decoding and metadata tracking
